sentences.en: Most would acknowledge that he was a sparkling young man.
sentences.zh: 大多数人都会承认他是个耀眼的年轻人。

sentences.en: First, we must acknowledge the errors made by our predecessors.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们必须承认前辈们所犯的错误。

sentences.en: I acknowledged that I want to do strange things.
sentences.zh: 我承认我想做一些奇怪的事情。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：ac+know（知道）+ledge→大家都知道了，所以不得不承认→承认
